chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Your turning away from him who inclines towards you is a loss of your share of advantage, and your inclining towards him who turns away from you is humiliation for yourself.
ai.seo_question: What is the wisdom behind not reciprocating interest in social relationships according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) outlines the ethics of social reciprocity, warning that rejecting a suitor results in a loss of potential benefit (nuqsan), while pursuing the indifferent leads to self-humiliation (dhull). This maxim reflects the Shia emphasis on maintaining dignified equilibrium (istiqama) in relationships, avoiding both arrogance in rejection and desperation in pursuit. It serves as a practical guide for preserving self-worth and social harmony within the community.
